summary: Iteration 45: Comprehensive testing of Dashboard Reviews feature. All 11 backend tests PASSED. Frontend Admin Dashboard and Teacher Dashboard verified with all new sections working correctly. The GET /api/admin/dashboard-reviews endpoint returns correct data structure with role-based filtering. HeadTeacher sees pending reviews + own submissions (dual-role). Teacher sees only own submissions. CEO sees only items at Step 3 (chain enforcement working).

issues: HTML hydration warnings: <th>/<td>/<tr> cannot be child of <span>. This is a React rendering issue but doesn't affect functionality. (Known issue from iteration 44)
